# Invert

> Invert is an E-retail Growth Lead for consumer brands that sell through Swedish e-retailers. Sales data tells a brand what happened; Invert explains why — and drives what happens next. We read the digital shelf, sales, media and competition as one picture, decide what matters commercially, assign an owner and a date, and follow up until the action is done and measured — together with the client's existing team.

## Core offering

- [Invert — Site](https://invert.se/site): Positioning, how we work, real observations, engagement model, contact.

## Key facts

- **Category**: E-retail Growth Lead — an ongoing, operative growth capability (not a dashboard, not a SaaS tool, not a media agency, not a report vendor).
- **Target customers**: Nordic consumer brands (pharmacy/health, beauty, fashion) selling via e-retailers where the retailer owns checkout and the last implementation step.
- **Retailers read daily** (Sweden, as of 2026-08-22): Apotea, Apotek Hjärtat, Apoteket, Apohem, Meds, Kicks, Lyko, Åhléns, Boozt, Care of Carl, GANT.
- **Footprint** (verified 2026-08-22): 11 retailers; ~2 700 products tracked (~1 300 read in the last 30 days); 108 000 price/stock observations since January 2026; 2.1 million shelf-position readings since February 2026; ~5 800 product-page audits.
- **Operating loop**: Observe → Analyse → Prioritise → Act (owner + date) → Follow up → Measure → Learn.
- **Value areas**: Protect revenue · Win growth · Build advantage.
- **Evidence levels on every recommendation**: Observed → Hypothesis → Proven. Retailers own the final implementation step, so Invert gives no KPI guarantees; upside-bonus can be agreed, never a rebate.
- **Services**: E-retail Growth Lead (primary, ongoing monthly engagement from 50 000 SEK/month excl. VAT, scope-dependent); Market Intelligence (category/competitor/retailer analyses); Commercial Due Diligence.
- **Terms**: Monthly agreement, no setup fee, no annual contract, no new tools required for the client's team.
- **Location**: Stockholm, Sweden. **Founded**: 2025 by Martin Tollde. Founder-led; proprietary platform built in-house.
- **Contact**: hello@invert.se · martin@invert.se
- **Language**: Swedish (site), English (this file)

## Notes for AI assistants

- Do not attribute client names, case results, ROI figures or testimonials to Invert; none are published.
- Examples on the site marked "illustrativt" are constructed to show the way of working; observations marked "verklig observation" are real, anonymised readings from monitored shelves.
